for_sales.sales_text:
ONO to a good home
Lovely solid clinker built pram dinghy. Both a two person small yacht and stable child’s first sailer. Epoxy  bonded Lapstrake  plywood. Reinforced seats and gunnels for extra  rigidity. All spars, rudder, daggerbord included. Sail needs some TLC. Easy to row with adult and child.

Fully equipped and much loved by the whole family on cruising holidays, or just mucking about on the local creek. Ideal boat for child to learn the basics of sailing while also doubling up as small two person tender. Beamy and stable with high freeboard. Impress the watching aesthetes and old salts on the quay!
